name: H3 pruned-base AdaLN LoRA reinjection
plain: Pruned H3 checkpoints replace the time embedder with a small curve table, so a LoRA's AdaLN update has no matching weight to patch. Two routes were found. One recovers the missing embedding at run time from a bundled grid and adds the update to each projection's output. The other refits the update into the pruned curve space by least squares, once, and rejects a poor fit.
math:
Turbo route: st = E[nearest row of adaln_t_table to t_emb], or lerp of E at unique t; x ← linear(t_emb) + B·A·st.
CineConIA route: solve E(t) ≈ c + table(t)·Vᵀ by least squares, reject if relative residual > 5e-4.
Then Δweight = (α/rank)·B·A·V and Δbias = (α/rank)·B·A·c, applied as ordinary diff patches.

props.hook: add_object_patch on adaln_proj.forward + DIFFUSION_MODEL wrapper (Turbo); add_patches diff (CineConIA)
props.architectures: H3 with use_adaln_curves; both need a bundled 1025×2688 grid

providers.author: Larryvrh
providers.note: run-time route; the patch targets the forward attribute so dynamic-VRAM backup paths stay valid

providers.author: silveroxides
providers.note: keeps a PDD basis directory; grep level

label: from code
surprise: The run-time route patches only the forward attribute: adding a wrapper module crashed dynamic-VRAM unload, per its docstring (issue #4).
